routes.reason: Smith theory for Hecke modules and the First Main Theorem have no owner in ArithmeticLocallySymmetricSpaces, so the Part II is justified. §§3–6 are numbered alike in both versions. The review added four items and a corrections paragraph to the brief: the nBr formula, the convergence in Theorem 4.4 and its part (b), Proposition 5.6, §2.11 and §6.4.

The dual-norm theory of §8 (published Theorem 8.10) and σ-dual homomorphisms belong in a Part II of ReductiveGroups. The review accepts the route, with its brief corrected. The published version only announces the Second Main Theorem, the preprint leaves Theorem 12.1(i)–(iii) unproved, and the q_v-normalisations of §§7.2–7.4 are inverted. The review added the published examples (§§9.4–9.7 and §1.2) as eight items and the mod p cyclotomic character as a library item.
The Satake isomorphism over k and the local representation theory belong to SR.0–SR.4. The review added the injectivity step of Satake (ii) (§7.3).

notes: The extraction read only the preprint, arXiv v1. The review read the published version (Ann. of Math. 183 (2016), 177–228; free on the Annals site) in full with four checkers and located every item in both versions. The published version keeps §§1–8, but drops the preprint's §§2.12–2.13, §7.8, Theorem 7.9, the §8.15 criterion and Lemma 8.16. It replaces §§9–12 (the existence of σ-dual homomorphisms) with a §9 of examples, and announces the existence theorem in §1.3 ('details will appear elsewhere'). Corrections were made in place: 35 statements and all 107 locators. There are 14 new items (1 library, 13 missing). E1–E4 are confirmed. E1–E3 are in passages absent from print, and E4 is in the c-group, which print drops. There are 49 new findings, E5–E53, 34 of them misprints. The substantive ones: (4.3.1) is wrong for non-σ-invariant h, but not used later. The proof of Theorem 4.4 has a convergence gap for unbounded singular chains, repaired with a bounded complex, and part (b) needs finite-dimensional cohomology. Proposition 5.6 must exclude the places where the fixed-point scheme has a disconnected special fibre. The q_v-normalisations of (7.2.1) and §7.4 are inverted (PGL_2 check). Remark 9.2 needs H semisimple. The preprint's Theorem 12.1(i)–(iii) are unproved, so its Theorem 9.1 is unproved in those rows. Theorems 4.4, 5.8, 6.5 and 8.10 stand.
